title: AN AIR STRIKE KILL IS NOT COUNTED ON YOUR GUN
why: Cloud robustness hunt. Every gun counts its kills from the mark the last blow leaves on a body: a round marks it with the gun, a swing, a frag or a barrel marks it as theirs. The air strike left no mark, so a body you had shot and then finished with the strike kept your round's mark, and the kill went on that gun's tally (and, inside 1.5 s and past 45 m, paid a LONG SHOT). Proven in headless Chromium on v27.32 (CAREER seed 3): a crawler last hit by the Scav Pistol, then killed by an air strike: the gun tally went from {} to {pistol:1}. Now the strike marks the bodies it hits as an air strike blow, so the kill counts as yours (the kill mark is untouched) but on no gun and as no gun style.
now: A kill made by your air strike is no longer added to the kill count of the last gun you hit that target with.
